title: dodag.py: duplicate SCHC version option validation
description:
**File:** python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py lines 625-631, python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py lines 939-945

**Severity:** P2 (maintenance risk)

**Summary:** The SCHC Rule Version option cardinality check (exactly one option required) is performed identically in both transact_authenticated_schc_dio (link_layer.py:939-945) and prepare_candidate (dodag.py:625-631).

**Failure scenario:** If the validation logic needs updating (e.g., different error message, different cardinality requirement), it must be updated in both places. Forgetting one leads to inconsistent error handling.

**Recommendation:** Remove the redundant check from dodag.py since transact_authenticated_schc_dio already validates this before calling prepare_candidate.
